name: Pass 21B meta-meta control-plane hardening
goal: Ensure merged control-plane records enforce required meta-meta outputs, per-node contracts, expert governance, and cross-record links.
risks: A meta-attractor record could omit required outputs while still passing
A control graph node could lack what why how where when who how good governance
Merged records could be valid individually but unrelated as a run

nodes.label: Second pass 21 critic review

node_contract.what: Review merged control-plane enforcement against transcript requirements.
node_contract.why: The system must not claim human-grade SDLC rigor with weak meta records.
node_contract.how: Apply system, governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.where: Meta-attractor validator, control graph template, pass records, and hardening runner.
node_contract.who: Codex acting through three expert perspectives.
node_contract.how_good: Every finding is concrete, fixed, and covered by regression evidence.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any new bypass becomes a validator/template patch or explicit residual risk.

node_contract.what: Patch meta-attractor validation and control graph template.
node_contract.why: Future Codex sessions must inherit enforceable node governance rules.
node_contract.how: Update installed skill files, sync workspace copies, and update pass records.
node_contract.how_good: The hardening runner rejects missing required outputs, missing node contracts, and orphan IDs.

nodes.label: Regression and evidence validation

node_contract.why: The patch must prove both acceptance and rejection behavior.
node_contract.how: Run the full DFMS hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and design records.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks are explicitly recorded.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed validation reopens fix work.
